name: steam-locomotive
draw: Side view of a steam locomotive with a tall smokestack puffing a cloud, round boiler front, cab at the back and large spoked driving wheels.

name: diesel-locomotive
draw: Side view of a boxy diesel locomotive with a flat-nosed cab at one end, a long engine hood with vent grilles and two wheel bogies.

name: electric-locomotive
draw: Side view of a boxy electric locomotive with a diamond-shaped pantograph on the roof touching a single overhead wire line.

name: shunting-locomotive
draw: Small stubby switcher locomotive in side view with a tall cab at one end, a short low hood and a coupler hook sticking out at the front.

name: streamlined-locomotive
draw: Side view of a sleek art deco steam locomotive with a smooth rounded bullet-shaped casing hiding the boiler and a skirt over the wheels.

name: maglev-train
draw: Streamlined train nose hovering a small gap above a thick T-shaped guideway, with short magnetic field arcs drawn in the gap.

name: vacuum-tube-train
draw: A capsule-shaped pod travelling inside a long transparent tube raised on pillars, with speed lines behind the pod.

name: double-decker-train
draw: Side view of a tall passenger rail carriage with two stacked rows of windows and wheel bogies under each end.

name: passenger-railcar
draw: Side view of a single passenger rail carriage with a row of square windows, a door at each end and two wheel bogies.

name: observation-car
draw: Side view of a rail carriage with a raised glass dome of curved windows on top of the middle of its roof.

name: sleeper-car
draw: Side view of a rail carriage with its windows showing stacked bunk beds and a small crescent moon above the roof.

name: dining-car
draw: Side view of a rail carriage with one wide window showing a small table with a lamp and a fork and knife symbol on the side.

name: flatcar
draw: Side view of a flat rail wagon with no sides, just a long deck on two bogies with short upright stakes along the edges.

name: container-wagon
draw: Side view of a low rail wagon carrying a ribbed shipping container, with wheel bogies under each end.

name: car-carrier-wagon
draw: Side view of a two-level rail wagon with car silhouettes parked on each deck inside an open frame.

name: caboose
draw: Side view of a small rail van with a raised cupola lookout box on the roof and railed platforms at both ends.

name: handcar
draw: Side view of a flat rail trolley with a seesaw pump handle on a central post, pushed up and down to drive it along the rails.

name: rail-bike
draw: A pedal cart with a bicycle-style seat and handlebars sitting on small flanged wheels on a railway track.

name: suspended-monorail
draw: Rail carriage hanging below a single overhead beam from arms on its roof, the beam held up by tall supports.

name: cable-tram
draw: Open-sided vintage tram car with bench seats, a sloped roof and a driver lever, running on street rails up a hill.

name: horse-drawn-tram
draw: Side view of an open tram car on street rails pulled by a single horse walking in front.

name: miniature-railway
draw: Tiny ride-on steam engine pulling low open cars with riders sitting astride them, on a narrow track.

name: railway-snowplow
draw: Side view of a rail vehicle with a large round rotary blower on its front throwing an arc of snow to one side.

name: rail-crane
draw: Side view of a rail wagon with a lattice jib crane mounted on top, the hook hanging from the end of the jib.

name: road-rail-truck
draw: Side view of a pickup truck sitting on railway track with small flanged rail wheels lowered in front of its tires.

name: train-wheel
draw: Side view of a single flanged railway wheel on an axle stub, sitting on a rail cross section.

name: train-coupler
draw: Two knuckle couplers from facing rail wagons locked together, drawn close up from the side.

name: cowcatcher
draw: Front of an old steam locomotive with a wedge-shaped slatted grille pointing forward at track level below the headlamp.

name: water-crane
draw: Tall railway water column with a swinging horizontal arm ending in a drooping leather hose, beside a track.

name: railway-lantern
draw: Old handheld railway guard lamp with a wire bail handle, a cylindrical body and a round glowing lens on the front.

name: jumbo-jet
draw: Side view of a large four-engine wide-body airliner with a distinctive raised hump over the front upper deck.

name: turboprop-plane
draw: Side view of a regional plane with straight high wings and a propeller engine on each wing, blades shown as discs.

name: light-aircraft
draw: Side view of a small single-engine high-wing plane with a nose propeller, a wing strut and fixed wheels.

name: biplane
draw: Side view of a vintage plane with two stacked wings joined by struts, a nose propeller and an open cockpit.

name: triplane
draw: Side view of a vintage plane with three stacked wings joined by struts and a nose propeller.

name: seaplane
draw: Side view of a small propeller plane sitting on two long pontoon floats instead of wheels, with a waterline below.

name: flying-boat
draw: Side view of a plane whose boat-shaped hull rests in the water, with high wings, small wingtip floats and engines on top.

name: glider-plane
draw: Side view of a sleek sailplane with very long thin wings, a bubble canopy and no engine.

name: hang-glider
draw: Triangular delta fabric wing seen from the front with a small pilot hanging below from a triangular control bar.

name: paraglider
draw: Wide curved arc-shaped canopy with many thin lines converging down to a small seated pilot.

name: paramotor
draw: Pilot seen from the side wearing a caged propeller fan on the back, hanging from a curved paraglider wing.

name: microlight
draw: Small open trike with three wheels and a pusher propeller, hanging under a triangular hang glider style wing.

name: fighter-jet
draw: Top view of a jet fighter with sharply swept delta wings, twin tail fins and a pointed nose.

name: flying-wing
draw: Top view of a tailless aircraft shaped like a wide boomerang with a jagged sawtooth back edge.

name: jump-jet
draw: Side view of a jet fighter hovering in place with two nozzles on its side pointing straight down blasting air.

name: cargo-plane
draw: Side view of a bulky high-wing transport plane with a T-tail and a lowered loading ramp at the rear with a crate.

name: supersonic-airliner
draw: Side view of a slender airliner with a drooped needle nose and large delta wings, sitting nose-down on long landing gear.

name: private-jet
draw: Side view of a small business jet with two engines mounted on the rear fuselage and a T-shaped tail.

name: firefighting-aircraft
draw: Side view of a propeller plane dropping a curtain of water from its belly onto flames below.

name: tiltrotor
draw: Front view of an aircraft with a wing on each side ending in an upright engine pod with a huge rotor on top.

name: autogyro
draw: Side view of a small open two-seat gyroplane with a free-spinning rotor on a mast and a pusher propeller at the back.

name: airship
draw: Side view of a long cigar-shaped airship with tail fins at the rear and a small gondola cabin under its belly.

name: weather-balloon
draw: Large round balloon rising on a long string with a small instrument box and a tiny parachute hanging below.

name: jetpack
draw: Back view of a jetpack harness with twin rocket tubes side by side, each blasting a short flame downward.

name: flying-car
draw: Side view of a small car with a rotor on each corner raised on short arms above the roof.

name: air-taxi
draw: Small passenger cabin pod with several rotors on arms around it, seen at a slight angle, hovering.

name: banner-towing-plane
draw: Small propeller plane in side view pulling a long rectangular banner on a line behind it.

name: aerial-refueling
draw: Tanker plane seen from the side with a long boom trailing back and down to a smaller jet flying close behind it.

name: radar-aircraft
draw: Side view of an airliner-shaped plane with a large flat disc radar dome mounted on struts above the rear fuselage.

name: solar-powered-aircraft
draw: Top view of a slender aircraft with extremely long straight wings covered in a grid of solar cells and several small propellers.

name: ground-effect-vehicle
draw: Side view of a big boat-like aircraft with short stubby wings skimming just above the waves, with spray behind it.

name: ornithopter
draw: Side view of a wooden flying machine with large bat-like flapping wings of ribs and fabric around a seated pilot.

name: air-show
draw: Small jet trailing a smoke trail that curls into a full loop behind it.

name: contrail
draw: Airliner high in the sky seen from below with two long parallel vapor trails streaming from its engines.

name: sonic-boom
draw: Jet in side view piercing a cone-shaped shock wave drawn as nested curved arcs around its nose.

name: air-turbulence
draw: Airliner in side view tilted slightly over a series of wavy bumpy air lines beneath it.

name: aircraft-propeller
draw: Front view of a three-blade airplane propeller with long twisted blades around a pointed spinner hub.

name: landing-gear
draw: Side view of an aircraft wheel strut with a hinged shock absorber leg and two wheels side by side.

name: aircraft-tail
draw: Side view of an airliner tail: a tall swept vertical fin with a rudder line and a horizontal stabilizer at its base.

name: control-yoke
draw: Airplane control yoke seen from the pilot seat: a ram-horn shaped wheel with two grips on a column.

name: aircraft-throttle
draw: Cockpit throttle quadrant with two parallel levers with knobs pushed forward in curved slots.

name: attitude-indicator
draw: Round cockpit gauge showing an artificial horizon split into sky and ground halves, with a fixed wings symbol in the center.

name: flight-recorder
draw: Rectangular crash-proof box with rounded edges and stripes, a cylindrical memory module and a carrying handle on top.

name: ejection-seat
draw: Cockpit seat shooting upward on a rocket flame with a small drogue parachute trailing above it.

name: pilot-helmet
draw: Side view of a jet pilot helmet with a tinted visor pulled down and an oxygen mask with a hose at the front.

name: aircraft-window
draw: Rounded oval airplane cabin window with a pull-down shade half lowered and a cloud visible outside.

name: airplane-seat
draw: Side view of a reclining airline seat with a headrest, armrest and a fold-down tray table on the seat back.

name: overhead-bin
draw: Airplane overhead luggage compartment with its curved door swung open and a small bag inside.

name: airline-trolley
draw: Narrow tall airline service cart on small wheels with stacked drawers and a bottle and cups on top.

name: airsickness-bag
draw: Paper sick bag with a folded top and a small printed wavy face symbol on the front.
